lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Reward: Suspicious Remote Control ×2

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It may not be much, but here you go!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: This is a small token of my appreciation

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: for your Nikke friends saving my life.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'll be grateful if you can pass it to them on my behalf.
Sure thing.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We made a significant breakthrough thanks to you guys!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I managed to finally prove the hypothesis

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I had about Sinister's ancestors!
What hypothesis?
What do you mean by ancestors?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: A few years ago,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I hypothesized that

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: higher class Raptures who lived longer

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: would eventually evolve to imitate more complex life forms.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: If that's true, the lower-class Raptures we examined previously

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: are mimicking relatively smaller and simpler forms of marine life.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Sinister, on the other hand, was imitating a much larger and more complicated organism, a shark.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: A Great White Shark, to be exact.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The moment I saw his movements up close, I was positive this was the case!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Did you see his fin softly cutting

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: through the blue sky? It was as he was swimming in the ocean.
Yes, I saw it.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: What a phenomenal sight!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: This must be what the deep-sea explorers felt

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: before the first Rapture invasion

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: when they delved into the ocean deep and

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: discovered a Great White Shark swimming in the darkness.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: blog.arkpia.com/raptilian

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: This is my blog url.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I can't wait to publish a post and share this incredible experience

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: we've had with everyone!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Is it okay if I include you in the post?
I'd rather you not since it can be dangerous.
That may not be a good idea since I'm a government soldier.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, right...

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Communication with Raptures is banned on the Ark.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've spent so much time on the surface that I completely forgot about it.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's too bad, then. The role you and your friends played in all this

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: will just remain a precious memory.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Well, so long!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Maybe you'll turn up in one of my future blog posts!
